name: IVR
tagline: International association representing inland waterway shipping, insurance, and classification interests
hero_kpi_rationale: Aucun indicateur financier n'est disponible puisque l'IVR est une association sans but lucratif. La participation au congrès annuel (225 participants en 2024) reflète l'engagement des membres et l'influence de l'organisation dans le secteur européen de la navigation intérieure.

kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the annual IVR Congress.
kpis.signal: Strong member engagement and sector representation
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt am Main welcomed 225 participants from 11 different countries, held May 15-17, 2024.

kpis.name_fr: Nombre de pays représentés au congrès
kpis.explanation: Number of different countries from which congress participants came.
kpis.description: The 2024 congress attracted participants from 11 European countries, demonstrating the organization's international scope.

kpis.name_fr: Participation au colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the inaugural IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium.
kpis.signal: New initiative with strong initial uptake
kpis.description: The first-ever Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany.

kpis.name_fr: Réunions du comité de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Annual number of in-person Loss Prevention Committee meetings held.
kpis.signal: Active committee governance and stakeholder engagement
kpis.description: The Loss Prevention Committee held 3 in-person meetings during 2024 to address technical regulations and prevention challenges.

kpis.name_fr: Participation aux réunions du comité CESNI
kpis.explanation: Number of CESNI (European standardization committee) meetings attended by IVR as observer.
kpis.signal: Active role in European inland waterway standardization
kpis.description: IVR participated as observer in multiple CESNI working group and committee meetings in 2024 (April 11 and October 17), contributing to standardization and digitalization in inland navigation.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, generative AI, or advanced technology integration in the 2024 annual report. The organization maintains focus on institutional representation, technical standardization, and loss prevention in inland waterway transportation.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, automation, or intelligent systems
Activities centered on regulatory representation, technical standards (CESNI), and safety protocols
Digitalization mentioned only in context of CESNI work on professional qualifications and basic digitalization in inland navigation, not AI-driven initiatives
Strategic priorities focus on sustainability, emissions reduction, and traditional maritime safety
